item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find direct 2024 evidence that Sharif personally used jobs, permits, food, or housing as explicit loyalty rewards or punishments.\nThe clearest evidence is instead indirect: formal welfare programs were described as nonpartisan, while vulnerable groups, minorities, protesters, and informal workers still faced coercion, exclusion, or punitive state action.\nSo the best-supported reading is not “systematic patronage through benefits,” but rather “some apolitical welfare delivery alongside weak protection of dignity and equal opportunity in practice.”","evidence":[{"title":"BISP assistance is explicitly apolitical and dignity-based","publisher":"Benazir Income Support Programme","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://www.bisp.gov.pk/NewsDetail/MjU0NDA1ZTItM2NiOC00NGE4LWJmNzctNGFiZTY4ZDFiZGFj","summary":"BISP says aid goes to poor and deserving people regardless of political affiliation, and that benefits should be delivered in a dignified, transparent way.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Sharif publicly promised equal opportunity for minorities","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-08-11","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/11-08-2024/pm-reassures-equal-opportunities-for-minorities","summary":"He said minorities are central to Pakistan’s stability and prosperity, that their constitutional rights would be protected, and that they should have equal opportunities. This is positive rhetoric, but not proof of durable implementation.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"The government said it was strengthening protections for vulnerable groups","publisher":"Press Information Department, Pakistan","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://pid.gov.pk/site/press_detail/27376","summary":"The state said it had enacted measures for vulnerable groups and strengthened commissions for women, children, human rights, and minorities. This supports an inclusion-oriented posture at the institutional level.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Sharif ordered prison sanitation and healthcare improvements","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent","summary":"After HRW reporting, Sharif ordered hygiene and healthcare measures in Lahore Central Prison and promised wider prison reforms. This is a concrete, narrow dignity-related intervention.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.6"]},{"title":"Ahmadis faced arrests, detention, and ritual bans","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-21","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/end-escalating-attacks-on-minority-ahmadiyya-community/","summary":"Amnesty documented 36 arbitrary arrests and detentions, police harassment, and orders barring Ahmadi religious rites, with authorities failing to protect the community. This is strong negative evidence on dignity and equal citizenship.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"Forced evictions targeted low-income residents and street vendors","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-05-28","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/28/pakistan-abusive-evictions-target-urban-poor","summary":"HRW found that authorities forcibly evicted low-income residents, shop owners, and street vendors without adequate notice, compensation, or resettlement, often with police abuse. This cuts against equal opportunity and basic dignity in housing and livelihood.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"The government cracked down on PTI protesters with arrests, roadblocks, and internet shutdowns","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-11-27","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/urgent-and-transparent-investigation-needed-into-deadly-crackdown-on-opposition-protesters/","summary":"Amnesty described deaths, mass detentions, highway barricades, and mobile internet shutdowns during the Islamabad crackdown, plus a broader pattern of intolerance for peaceful assembly. That is negative evidence for equal civic dignity.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7","6B.6"]},{"title":"Undocumented Afghans remained vulnerable to abuse and faced barriers to work and school","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent","summary":"HRW said undocumented Afghans faced abuse by police and district administrations and had difficulty accessing employment and education. This is negative evidence on equal opportunity for a vulnerable population.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]}]}
